summary: Qfin Holdings, Inc., a Cayman Islands-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 13, 2026, containing a Hong Kong Stock Exchange announcement. The filing notifies of a board meeting scheduled for August 25, 2026, to approve the unaudited Q2 and interim 2026 financial results and consider any dividend recommendation. The results and earnings call details are provided for August 26, 2026. This is routine corporate housekeeping regarding scheduled financial reporting, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic action, or event affecting shareholders' rights or capital structure is involved. The filing merely sets dates for standard periodic disclosure obligations.
